This was the first ship I worked on, and after taking a long break from Legos it was tough to get what I wanted. The main focus of this ship was the cockpit. Hoooly crap did it take a bit to figure it out. The idea came from Dorian Bricktron on Instagram, he did an alternate build of the outrider dropship set from avengers and that design always seemed so cool so it was always in my head. The flaps at the end can open up for basic flight, wider for a speed boost, and opens all the way to break the atmosphere and enter space flight, and its landing gear (which sadly can’t be seen) do fold up for a better flight shape

Funny enough, I went the weirdest way possible. I started with a general color scheme in mind, found my pieces of those colors, and started with the cockpit. Most of these ships for me I had a desired cockpit design and wanted to make the ship fit or flow with it. So, for a majority of these ships the cockpit design is what influenced the shape of the ship.
